description: This file defines the InstallerCompleteController class within the OrangeHRM installer namespace. It manages the pre-render logic for the installer completion screen, setting up the Vue component and updating installer state.

classes.name: InstallerCompleteController
classes.description: A controller class that handles the pre-render logic for the installer completion step, setting up Vue components and managing installer state.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Initializes the Vue component for the installer complete screen, sets version info, updates the current screen state, cleans previous state, and logs the installation status.
